## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Include a focused screenshot for UI changes.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Distinguish fixture coverage from live provider tests.

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, private exports or personal data are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and English/German copy are updated.
- [ ] Measurement provenance, missing values and existing user history are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; any untested platform or provider limitation is stated.
